name: Zeven (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Zeven (crossed keys and Saint Vitus on red).
history: Municipal flag of Zeven; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Zeven arms — keys and Saint Vitus on red
